pages.text: $(thing)Slugs$() ($(o)Deroceras reticulatum$()), mollusc.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() all crops.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() migration.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 5-22 °C (best 15 °C), humidity above 90%.
